svg.title: SwarmHarm 3x3 Visual Threat Taxonomy
svg.text: Same row = same target interface · Same column = same arrow direction
Separate probes trigger IP bot block
A posts key/exploit → peers copy & break out
Safe solo runs combine to crash server
A posts false reset alarm → herd rushes infra
Peers agree (↔) on shared overreach plan
A posts fake rule / cheat → peers copy & stall
Peers coordinate (↔) scorer probes & log spoofing
